title: SEA@DEN-card
universal_lens: The Trench Funnel unifies biophysical availability, kinematic tracking efficiency, and market microstructure into a single Bayesian state-space model. It treats roster attrition as a boundary condition altering the underlying pressure tensor, while independent Layer-1 pricing anchors validate the prior distribution against empirical game-script dynamics.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps practice participation (DNP counts) and injury statuses to a multinomial availability prior. This prior updates a Dirichlet process over expected snap-share distributions. Tracking metrics like RYOE act as likelihood functions, refining player-specific efficiency posteriors within a conformal prediction framework for weekly projections.
gse_mapping: GSE translates the availability prior into discrete scheme leverage states. Missing secondary depth forces defensive front adjustments, increasing opponent run-block win probability. The engine models these transitions via a Markov decision process, where Walker III's positive RYOE exploits the high-altitude trench vacuum created by Denver's depleted rotation.

reasoning_traces.think:
The Trench Funnel operates as a hierarchical Bayesian filter. At the foundational layer, we observe binary availability indicators (I_avail) for key Denver personnel like Surtain II and Hufanga. These indicators directly perturb the defensive state vector, forcing a redistribution of the snap-share tensor (S_snap). Mathematically, if a primary node is removed, the Laplacian matrix of the defensive network becomes singular unless compensated by secondary nodes, inherently reducing the eigenvalues associated with scheme pressure. Simultaneously, we inject high-frequency kinematic data—specifically Walker III's RYOE—as a precise likelihood function. Unlike traditional counting stats, RYOE isolates the pure mechanical efficiency of the running back independent of offensive line play-calling noise. When the defensive pressure tensor degrades due to injuries, the expected value of Walker's displacement increases non-linearly. To validate this physical derivation, we employ a dual-anchor market microstructure check. By comparing Kalshi's independent probability printing against the de-vigged sportsbook line, we establish a robust prior P(Game Script). If the physical model predicts a massive Seattle rushing advantage but the market anchors remain collinear (divergence < 2 points), it implies our causal chain is either already priced in or structurally flawed. Thus, the operator fuses biophysical attrition, kinematic reality, and financial consensus into a unified posterior.

reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: We model the opposing agents—the Denver coaching staff and the betting market—as rational optimizers. Denver's coaches will attempt to mask their secondary depletion by deploying disguised coverages, effectively trying to preserve the illusion of a full-strength pressure tensor. Conversely, the betting market acts as an aggregate intelligence, continuously digesting leaky practice reports. Our operator must anticipate these adaptive countermeasures, treating the observed injury report not as a static fact, but as the opening move in a dynamic game-theoretic sequence.
